**English** · [Français](#français)

Portable builds, no installer: unzip / untar anywhere and run. `ffmpeg` is not included (see the README: the program downloads it on Windows and Linux, SHA-256 checked; on macOS install it with Homebrew or place it next to the app).

| System | Archive |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-win64.zip` |
| Linux x86-64 | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |
| Linux ARM64 | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-macos-universal.zip` |

SHA-256 sums: `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Documentation: [README](https://github.com/ap3demak-rgb/ShaderToMP4#readme) · Website: https://ap3demak-rgb.github.io/ShaderToMP4
